engines.notes: Uses OS-native speech engines through secure shell execution.
engines.language_notes: Language coverage follows the host's installed OS voices (macOS say / Linux espeak / Windows SAPI); declared '*' because the voice list, not the engine, decides it (voice chosen per language via voice-tts-config).

engines.notes: Configured espeak-ng fallback with governed bridge script.
engines.language_notes: espeak-ng itself covers 100+ languages, but the runtime passes only lang_code ja/en to the bridge (runPythonTtsBridge), so only en/ja are declared.

engines.notes: Shadow candidate profile. Governance keeps fallback deterministic until promoted.
engines.language_notes: Shadow placeholder without a bridge in this repository; language coverage unknown, conservatively en only.

engines.notes: 8-bit quantized Qwen3-TTS 1.7B via mlx-audio. ICL voice cloning using ref_audio + ref_text — no fine-tuning required. Requires Apple Silicon (M1+) and governed tool-runtime entries for mlx_audio and mlx_whisper. Shadow until governance promotion.
engines.language_notes: Upstream Qwen3-TTS covers more languages, but the runtime passes only lang_code ja/en to the bridge, so only ja/en are declared.

engines.notes: 82M parameter lightweight local TTS. Japanese voice selection depends on the installed Kokoro language pack.
engines.language_notes: Bridge maps ja to the Kokoro 'j' pipeline and everything else to American English ('a'); ja needs the installed Kokoro Japanese language pack.

engines.notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS preview through Google AI Studio / Gemini API using GEMINI_API_KEY.
engines.language_notes: Upstream Gemini TTS auto-detects many languages; only en/ja are exercised in this repository, so only those are declared.

engines.notes: CPU streaming TTS and consent-gated voice cloning. Current upstream language packs do not include Japanese.
engines.language_notes: Bridge rejects Japanese; upstream packs for fr/de/pt/it/es exist but the bridge does not select a language pack, so only en is declared.
